overview.description: The ARK Active Autocallable Income ETF (ARKY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF aiming to provide income while offering a defined downside barrier. The ETF uses derivatives to create a portfolio of synthetic equity-linked notes (ELNs), which references a stock from ARKs high-conviction innovation universe. ARKY was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by ARK.
